Event Start
	Form.Caption = Format("GXSPC_SelectionList", "Plan070 Trn")
	&ADVANCED_LABEL_TEMPLATE = "%1 <strong>%2</strong>"
EndEvent

Event 'Toggle'
	if AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerVisible
		BtnToggle.Class += !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggleActive
	else
		AdvancedContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainer
		BtnToggle.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aBtnToggle
	endif
Endevent

Event LblPlan070TrnIdFilter.Click
	if Plan070TrnIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		Plan070TrnIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem + !" " + StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItemExpanded
		&cPlan070TrnId.Visible = true
	else
		Plan070TrnIdFilterContainer.Class = StyleClass:d52f9833-90c9-4096-8e42-27485741f78aAdvancedContainerItem
		&cPlan070TrnId.Visible = false
	endif
EndEvent

Event Load
	&LinkSelection.FromImage(selectRow)
EndEvent

Event Enter
	&pPlan070TrnId = Plan070TrnId
	Return
EndEvent
